SELECT coalesce(sum(rack_count),0) AS "Racks" FROM inventory.data_center_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring})
SELECT coalesce(sum(server_count),0) AS "Physical Servers" FROM inventory.data_center_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring})
SELECT coalesce(sum(vm_count),0) AS "Virtual Machines" FROM inventory.data_center_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring})
SELECT coalesce(sum(open_alerts),0) AS "Open Alerts" FROM inventory.data_center_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring})
SELECT coalesce(sum(unmonitored_assets),0) AS "Unmonitored Assets" FROM inventory.data_center_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Kubernetes Pods" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR c.site_id=(SELECT id FROM inventory.sites WHERE site_key=${site:sqlstring}))

SELECT count(DISTINCT aps.application_id) AS "Applications" FROM inventory.application_sites aps JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",s.latitude::double precision AS latitude,s.longitude::double precision AS longitude,count(DISTINCT r.id)::bigint AS "Rack Count",count(DISTINCT sv.id)::bigint AS "Server Count",CASE WHEN s.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.sites s LEFT JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.site_id=s.id LEFT JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.room_id=rm.id LEFT JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.row_id=dr.id LEFT JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.rack_id=r.id WHERE s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) GROUP BY s.id,s.name,s.latitude,s.longitude,s.is_simulated ORDER BY s.name

targets.rawSql: SELECT initcap(health_status) AS "Health",name AS "Data Center",site_key AS "Site Key",region AS "Region",initcap(replace(environment,'_',' ')) AS "Environment",rack_count AS "Racks",server_count AS "Servers",vm_count AS "VMs",round(100*facility_power_used_kw/nullif(facility_power_capacity_kw,0),1) AS "Power %",facility_power_used_kw AS "Power kW",temperature_c AS "Temp °C",humidity_pct AS "Humidity %",pue AS "PUE",open_alerts AS "Alerts",monitoring_coverage_pct AS "Monitoring %",owner AS "Owner",last_seen_at AS "Last Seen",CASE WHEN is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.data_center_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE health_status WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", vm.name AS "VM", vm.hostname AS "Hostname", h.hypervisor_type AS "Hypervisor", sv.hostname AS "Physical Host", vm.vcpu_count AS "vCPU", pg_size_pretty(vm.memory_bytes) AS "RAM", pg_size_pretty(vm.provisioned_storage_bytes) AS "Provisioned Storage", vm.operating_system AS "OS", vm.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN vm.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.virtual_machines vm JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=h.server_id JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,vm.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", c.name AS "Cluster", n.name AS "Node", ns.name AS "Namespace", w.workload_type AS "Kind", w.name AS "Workload", p.name AS "Pod", p.phase AS "Phase", kc.name AS "Container", kc.image AS "Image", CASE WHEN p.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_nodes n ON n.id=p.node_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_workloads w ON w.id=p.workload_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_containers kc ON kc.pod_id=p.id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,c.name,ns.name,p.name,kc.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", nd.hostname AS "Device", nd.device_type AS "Type", nd.role AS "Role", nd.manufacturer AS "Vendor", nd.model AS "Model", nd.management_address::text AS "Management IP", r.name AS "Rack", nd.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN nd.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.network_devices nd JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=nd.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,nd.hostname

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", a.name AS "Application", a.environment AS "Environment", a.criticality AS "Criticality", ac.name AS "Component", ac.component_type AS "Type", ac.runtime AS "Runtime", ac.version AS "Version", a.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN a.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.application_components ac ON ac.application_id=a.id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,a.name,ac.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",r.name AS "Rack",r.rack_units AS "Total U",coalesce((r.attributes->>'used_rack_units')::int,0) AS "Used U",r.rack_units-coalesce((r.attributes->>'used_rack_units')::int,0) AS "Free U",round(100*coalesce((r.attributes->>'used_rack_units')::numeric,0)/r.rack_units,1) AS "Space Used %",round(coalesce((r.attributes->>'current_power_watts')::numeric,0)/1000,1) AS "Power Used kW",round(r.max_power_watts::numeric/1000,1) AS "Power Capacity kW",r.status AS "Status" FROM inventory.racks r JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,r.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",sv.hostname AS "Asset",'Server' AS "Type",initcap(sv.status) AS "Status",initcap(sv.attributes->>'criticality') AS "Criticality",sv.attributes->>'business_service' AS "Business Service",initcap(sv.attributes->>'monitoring_status') AS "Monitoring",sv.last_seen_at AS "Last Seen",sv.attributes->>'warranty_expiry' AS "Warranty Expiry",CASE WHEN sv.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.servers sv JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (sv.status<>'active' OR sv.last_seen_at<now()-interval '30 minutes' OR sv.attributes->>'monitoring_status'='unmonitored' OR (sv.attributes->>'warranty_expiry')::date<=current_date+interval '180 days') ORDER BY CASE sv.status WHEN 'failed' THEN 1 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,sv.hostname
